msg: This game is confusing, and I could not see a correlation bewteen which gnome to pick. Although some gnomes had more mushrooms, for example the long hat pink gnome seemed to have more mushrooms than the brown gnome. I think the long purple gnome has more than the short yellow gnome too. I couldn't tell a difference between the short red and orange but I think the red has slightly more - I suggest switching that up a bit. To be honest it might be random, so just go with your gut for whatever you think is good to go for. Remember to press the space bar quickly and also use the breaks if you need them cause my eyes went funny lol.
